title: Tensor trivializations on the fibre-product refinement of constructible stratifications
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $A,B$ sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $\Lambda_X$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Use the ordinary sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and module inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Let $(\iota_k:Z_k\to X)_{k<n}$ and $(\kappa_l:W_l\to X)_{l<m}$ be specified finite scheme stratifications [def-constructible-stratification] with constructible images [def-weil-constructible-subset], witnessing constructibility of $A$ and $B$ respectively [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Thus $\iota_k^{-1}A$ and $\kappa_l^{-1}B$ are etale locally constant sheaves of finite $\Lambda$-modules, with trivializations linear over the corresponding constant ring sheaves. Put $V_{k,l}=Z_k\times_XW_l$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $p_{k,l},q_{k,l}$ and $\mu_{k,l}=\iota_kp_{k,l}=\kappa_lq_{k,l}$. Then $(\mu_{k,l}:V_{k,l}\to X)_{k<n,l<m}$ is a finite scheme stratification with constructible images $\iota_k(Z_k)\cap\kappa_l(W_l)$. Both $p_{k,l}^{-1}\iota_k^{-1}A$ and $q_{k,l}^{-1}\kappa_l^{-1}B$ are finite locally constant as $\Lambda_{V_{k,l}}$-module sheaves. There are canonical $\Lambda_{V_{k,l}}$-linear isomorphisms, natural in $A,B$,
$$\mu_{k,l}^{-1}(A\otimes_{\Lambda_X}B)\xrightarrow{\sim}p_{k,l}^{-1}\iota_k^{-1}A\otimes_{\Lambda_{V_{k,l}}}q_{k,l}^{-1}\kappa_l^{-1}B.$$
Here the coefficient rings are identified by the canonical constant-ring inverse-image maps, and the tensor isomorphisms are the ordinary module-pullback tensor comparisons. Their right-hand sides are finite locally constant module sheaves. Consequently these specified fibre-product strata witness constructibility of $A\otimes_{\Lambda_X}B$. Neither $A$ nor $B$ is assumed flat; no Noetherian or quasi-compact hypothesis on $X$ is required.

proof.text: Add the assumed constructibility fields to the prescribed finite locally closed stratifications to obtain S-prime and T-prime. Their common refinement Stratification.inter has exactly the specified fibre-product domains and composite first-projection immersions, indexed by finProdFinEquiv. Compute each range using Pullback.range_fst and Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range. Intersect constructible strata. The union is X by distributivity of intersections over unions; distinct pairs have a distinct coordinate, and disjointness in that coordinate implies disjointness of intersections.

lean.statement: theorem constructible_tensor_refinement_witness {X : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (A B : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (S T : FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X) (hS : ∀ k, Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum k)) (hT : ∀ l, Topology.IsConstructible (T.stratum l)) (hA : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (S.immersion k)).obj A)) (hB : ∀ l, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (T.immersion l)).obj B)) : (∀ (k : Fin S.n) (l : Fin T.n), IsImmersion (pullback.fst (S.immersion k) (T.immersion l) ≫ S.immersion k) ∧ Set.range (pullback.fst (S.immersion k) (T.immersion l) ≫ S.immersion k) = S.stratum k ∩ T.stratum l ∧ Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum k ∩ T.stratum l)) ∧ (⋃ (k : Fin S.n) (l : Fin T.n), S.stratum k ∩ T.stratum l) = Set.univ ∧ Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint (fun kl : Fin S.n × Fin T.n ↦ S.stratum kl.1 ∩ T.stratum kl.2)) ∧ (∀ (k : Fin S.n) (l : Fin T.n), IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.fst (S.immersion k) (T.immersion l))).obj ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (S.immersion k)).obj A)) ∧ IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.snd (S.immersion k) (T.immersion l))).obj ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (T.immersion l)).obj B)) ∧ IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.fst (S.immersion k) (T.immersion l))).obj ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (S.immersion k)).obj A) ⊗ (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.snd (S.immersion k) (T.immersion l))).obj ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (T.immersion l)).obj B)) ∧ IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (pullback.fst (S.immersion k) (T.immersion l) ≫ S.immersion k)).obj (A ⊗ B))) ∧ IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf (A ⊗ B)
